note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 21 were held and are listed below with their citations; 27 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_packet_internetworking, core_combined_cycle_turbine, comp_risc_superscalar, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, ener_crystalline_silicon_module, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_industrial_robotics, matl_lean_production, matl_rare_earth_magnet, matl_stereolithography, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_recon_satellite, bio_oral_rehydration, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, agri_drip_irrigation, agri_composite_membrane, agri_conservation_tillage, agri_integrated_pest_management, agri_protected_cultivation, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

COLLISION RESOLVED. Two authoring boards ruled the same cell for this nation and disagreed. The tie-break is uniform across the whole roster and is not a preference between authors: the cell belongs to the board that owns the technology's domain in the registry, which for every non-core id is also its id prefix, and which both cross-domain authors published as their own deferral. core_packet_internetworking -> NOT HELD (semiconductors-computing said held, telecom-space said not held; resolved to the board that owns the Communications domain, telecom-space).

SECOND AUTHORING PASS, 2026-08-31, USE-SIDE ONLY. The first pass was correctly instructed to rule NOT HELD when unsure, and produced a defensible but ragged board: the convergence channel was reading that transcription's INCOMPLETENESS as this nation's IGNORANCE, and paying it to catch up to things it already had. A second pass therefore re-ruled the 31 USE-SIDE nodes against an explicit standard published before any nation was looked at, each limb written separately into every source string. LIMB A: a citable fact putting the technology in general commercial or public service across the OECD on or before 31 December 1989, asserted once per technology and identical for every nation. LIMB B: the nation is in the Advanced Set - 1990 OECD member AND World Bank high-income in the 1990 groupings AND one of the 29 authored majors: australia canada france germany italy japan netherlands spain sweden switzerland uk usa. LIMB C: a performed and RECORDED search for a named fact placing the nation outside that deployment; a silent limb C is a failed limb C. Where limb A failed for a technology the board said so and fell back to the first pass's named-artefact bar rather than granting on the class claim - which is why several second-pass refusals contradict the brief's own opening cut. THE SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE BAR IS UNCHANGED: producing a jet engine is still producing a jet engine, and not one of the 17 sovereignty-side ids was added, removed or re-reasoned by this pass. THE PASS IS ADDITIONS-ONLY - no first-pass grant was removed or weakened - and it was authored blind of model output, with the simulation never run and no CAGR, gap or instrument reading consulted. ADDED BY THE SECOND PASS FOR THIS NATION, 3 cells: bio_monoclonal_antibody (health and agriculture board), bio_recombinant_pharma (health and agriculture board), ener_horizontal_drilling (energy and transport board). The refused list above has been reduced by exactly those ids and by nothing else; every other first-pass refusal stands untouched, and each new grant carries its own citation below.

granted.source: Route (b), inherited from comp_microprocessor: World Bank IT.CMP.PCMP.P2 1990 = 7.06 PCs per 100, against the 1990 World value of 2.45.

Submarcom supplied one of the three separately-contracted subsegments of TAT-8, the first transoceanic fibre-optic cable, in service 14 December 1988 - a repeatered single-mode system, proving French supply of fibre, lasers, submerged regenerators and terminals together. France Telecom was one of TAT-8's three managing owners with AT&T and British Telecom.

Soficar (Societe des Fibres de Carbone), the Toray / Elf Aquitaine joint venture established in the early 1980s, produced Torayca carbon fibre at Abidos in the Pyrenees-Atlantiques; prepreg from Brochier at Villeurbanne, taken over by Hexcel in the mid-1980s.

France's molecular-genetics base: the Institut Pasteur in Paris, where Barre-Sinoussi and Montagnier isolated HIV in 1983, and the Centre d'Etude du Polymorphisme Humain founded by Jean Dausset in 1984, which built the reference family panel used for human genetic mapping worldwide. Both were running amplification-based work by the end of the decade.
World Bank IT.CMP.PCMP.P2 1990 = 7.06 PCs per 100, 2.9x the World value of 2.45.
Oracle established a French subsidiary within three years of 1982 (Oracle corporate histories, as above). France also holds comp_microprocessor at 7.06 PCs per 100.

Alcatel's E10 was the world's first digital public telephone exchange and France Telecom's digitalisation ran on it and on System 12 through the 1980s; R3 confirms independently - French NMT-450 cellular service opened in April 1989, and World Bank WDI IT.CEL.SETS records 283,200 French mobile cellular subscriptions in 1990.

Telecom 1A, the first of France's national communications satellites, was launched by Ariane on 4 August 1984. The Telecom 1 spacecraft were designed and manufactured by Matra with the communications package supplied by Alcatel Espace. French prime contractor, French payload.

The French NMT-450 service began operating in April 1989 (Nordic Mobile Telephone country launch record), alongside the earlier Radiocom 2000 service. World Bank WDI IT.CEL.SETS records 283,200 French mobile cellular subscriptions in 1990.

LIMB A FAILS and is not used - a handful of named campaigns worldwide, not general service. Granted on the named-artefact bar, on exactly the predicate the board already applied to Italy: the wells are in this nation's fields, by whatever operator. LIMB B: France is in the Advanced Set. EVIDENCE E2, named wells in named French fields, dated: Elf Aquitaine drilled four horizontal wells in three European fields between 1980 and 1983, and THREE OF THE FOUR WERE IN FRANCE. In May 1980, after two years of preparation, Elf drilled its first test well in Lacq Superieur, an old and shallow (600 m) reservoir in south-western France; the first two horizontal wells, LACQ 90 and LACQ 91, were devoted to mastering the drilling, completion and measurement techniques. The fourth well of the programme, CASTERA LOU 110, also in south-western France, was designed to master deep horizontal drilling operations. The first of the four wells produced its first barrel of oil in August 1980 and the others followed between 1981 and 1983. Production from the campaign was still being reported to the industry five years on: 'Production From Horizontal Wells After 5 Years', Journal of Petroleum Technology 39(11), November 1987. The remaining well of that same four-well campaign is Rospo Mare, offshore Italy - the registry's own cited exemplar and the sole basis of the board's existing Italy grant. LIMB C SEARCHED: no named, citable fact was found placing France outside horizontal drilling. The contrary evidence is as strong as it gets - Elf Aquitaine is the operator that made the modern technique work, and it did so in French fields first. DISCLOSED LIMIT: the campaign of record is 1980-83, and I did not find a named French horizontal well spudded in 1988 or 1989. The grant rests on France having drilled and produced horizontal wells in French fields from August 1980, with production documented in the SPE literature through at least 1987, rather than on drilling activity in the last year before the start date.
Dassault flew the Rafale A demonstrator with a carbon-fibre wing on 4 July 1986; Aerospatiale built composite main rotor blades in series for the Dauphin family.
SNECMA and ONERA developed the AM1 single-crystal alloy in the early 1980s and it went into the M88, which first ran in 1989 as the Rafale's engine.

Aerospatiale AS.30 Laser air-to-surface missile with a Thomson-CSF semi-active laser seeker, delivered to the Armee de l'Air in the late 1980s and used in combat by Jaguars over Iraq in January 1991; Matra BGL laser-guided bomb family (BGL-400/BGL-1000) in French service from the mid-1980s; Thomson-CSF ATLIS II laser designation pod in service on the Jaguar from 1979. Seeker, weapon and designator are all French design and French production.

Thomson-CSF RDI (radar Doppler a impulsions) pulse-Doppler look-down/shoot-down radar in the Mirage 2000C standard S4, in Armee de l'Air service from 1987 and paired with the Super 530D; preceded by the RDM multimode radar in the Mirage 2000 from 1984.

Rubis-class SSN, lead boat commissioned 23 February 1983, with the L'Inflexible SSBN commissioned 1 April 1985; the class's acoustic-quieting programme, AMETHYSTE, produced S605 Amethyste, launched 14 May 1988 and fitting out on 1 January 1990 (commissioned 20 March 1992), with the earlier boats refitted to that standard. GRANTED ON A LAUNCHED HULL, not a commissioned one: the sovereignty-side predicate asks whether the nation could BUILD it, and a hull launched to the quieting standard in May 1988 demonstrates that. If the integrator prefers a commissioned-boat test, France flips to NOT HELD and the holder count becomes three.

LIMB A as in the technology note, and France is where limb A bites hardest - the French pituitary hGH contamination is the reference case for why the substitution was not optional. LIMB B: Advanced Set. CLASS E2: Job JC, Rochiccioli P, Rappaport R, Raux-Demay MC (French Multicentre Trial Group, Paris), '1-year treatment with recombinant somatropin in prepubertal and pubertal growth hormone deficient patients: results from a French multicentre trial', Acta Paediatrica Scandinavica Supplement 1988;347:187-90 (PMID 3075838). A national multicentre programme with one full year of recombinant somatropin completed and reported by 1988, so treatment began 1986-87. Corroborated by the French review '[Biosynthetic growth hormone: current therapeutic status and perspectives]', Pediatrie 1989 (PMID 2567981), Service de Pediatrie, hopital Edouard-Herriot, Lyon, whose title asserts a CURRENT THERAPEUTIC STATUS rather than a prospect. LIMIT STATED HONESTLY: the strongest French citation I hold is a national multicentre programme rather than an ANSM/AMM authorisation date; I looked for the French marketing authorisation date and could not reach a published one. LIMB C SEARCHED: nothing found placing France outside recombinant-protein prescribing.
WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 coverage, France, 1990: 94%. Series: WUENIC DTP3 ('France,FRA,1990,94').

Grant rests on the MRI-and-conventional-CT half. Compagnie Generale de Radiologie (CGR), the French medical imaging manufacturer, built computed-tomography and magnetic-resonance systems in France until General Electric acquired it from Thomson in 1987 in the exchange of GE's consumer-electronics business for Thomson's medical one; French teaching hospitals operated both modalities through the 1980s.

NAMED-ARTEFACT BAR, CLASS E2, two named French transplant units and two organs: Kreis H, Chkoff N, Chatenoud L, Debure A, 'A randomized trial comparing the efficacy of OKT3 used to prevent or to treat rejection', Transplantation Proceedings 1989;21(1 Pt 2):1741-4 (PMID 2652570), Transplantation Unit, Necker Hospital, Paris - a trial of PROPHYLAXIS versus RESCUE presupposes an established rescue practice; and Gugenheim J, Samuel D, Chaland F, Saliba F, 'Prophylactic ATG or OKT3 in liver transplantation in the presence of contraindications to cyclosporine or azathioprine', Transplantation Proceedings 1989;21(1 Pt 2):2257 (PMID 2652733), Groupe de Recherche de Chirurgie Hepatique, Hopital Paul Brousse, Villejuif. LIMB C SEARCHED: nothing found.

French customs' SOFI (Systeme d'Ordinateurs pour le traitement du Fret International) was introduced in 1978, extending to all transport modes the air-cargo SOFIA launched in 1974 and operational at Roissy and Orly from 1976; it was run by the Douane jointly with the FFCAT (Federation Francaise des Commissionnaires et Auxiliaires de Transport), the SNCF and other trade operators. Association pour l'Histoire de l'Administration des Douanes, 'L'informatisation du dedouanement'; DGDDI lexicon entry 'SOFI'. The Le Havre port community system SOGET followed in 1983.

LGV Sud-Est, the purpose-built Paris-Lyon high-speed line, opened to the public on 27 September 1981 (inaugurated 22 September 1981) and was worked at 270 km/h; the LGV Atlantique opened on 24 September 1989, three months before the start date. Wikipedia, 'LGV Sud-Est' and 'LGV Atlantique'.
